items.title: Complete plan fidelity
items.acceptance: Single-task execution retains objective, role, files, constraints, dependencies, success criteria and model selection.

items.title: Original scan archives
items.acceptance: Full baseline scan evidence is archived before bounded prompt extraction and recoverable by reference.

items.title: Honest coverage
items.acceptance: Reports distinguish reviewed, skipped, failed and unknown inputs; empty output never proves safety.

items.title: Occurrence identities
items.acceptance: Same-rule findings at separate locations retain separate stable identities with migration compatibility.

items.title: Suppression preservation
items.acceptance: Imports and synchronization retain false-positive/suppression decisions.

items.title: Enforced write scopes
items.acceptance: Parallel writer tools enforce inherited canonical write scopes; unconfined process tools cannot run concurrently.

items.title: Verification freshness
items.acceptance: Verification fingerprints source, dependency manifests, configuration and fixture changes and invalidates stale proof.

items.title: Acceptance evidence
items.acceptance: Acceptance criteria have observed checks or explicit unresolved status; model assertion alone never completes a goal.

items.title: Mutation interruption
items.acceptance: Crash-boundary tests prove unknown mutation completion cannot replay automatically.

items.title: Streaming output bounds
items.acceptance: Subprocess stdout/stderr are drained with bounded memory while the full child lifecycle remains controlled.

items.title: Fresh Python verification
items.acceptance: Same-second same-size Python edits cannot reuse stale test bytecode.

items.title: Bounded event history
items.acceptance: Per-task histories and websocket queues have enforced bounds and truthful overflow behavior.

items.title: Comprehensive cancellation
items.acceptance: Cancelling parent execution stops descendants, subagents, queued operations and pending approvals with tests.

items.title: Shared engine ownership
items.acceptance: Concurrent manager/IDE startup and owner exit are tested for one authenticated workspace engine.

items.title: Native release matrix
items.acceptance: Independent Linux, Windows and macOS test/build gates exist; unavailable runner results remain unverified.

items.title: Incremental UI polling
items.acceptance: Idle polling excludes full reports, diffs and file walks; selection/workspace views request needed data.

items.title: Incremental indexing
items.acceptance: Unchanged indexed source chunks are reused and changed/deleted sources invalidate correctly.

items.title: Catalog snapshot cache
items.acceptance: Normalized catalogs cache by file identity/freshness without relaxing quota or context admission.

items.title: Relevant tool schemas
items.acceptance: A deterministic role/task-aware catalog bounds schemas with explicit permitted discovery.

items.title: Context composition
items.acceptance: Each request reports bounded instruction/schema/history/retrieval/output attribution without prompt leakage.

items.title: Tokenizer provenance
items.acceptance: Exact supported local tokenizer accounting and conservative fallback are distinguishable.

items.title: Hypothesis retrieval
items.acceptance: Retrieval incorporates bounded current hypotheses and recent observations, preserving original task constraints.

items.title: Evidence deduplication
items.acceptance: Identical unchanged evidence is referenced compactly; changed evidence and full originals remain recoverable.

items.title: Symbol-first context
items.acceptance: Language context returns bounded symbol definitions/callers/references with explicit fallback coverage.

items.title: Compaction fidelity gates
items.acceptance: Tests preserve constraints, decisions, failures, next work and source references across compaction.

items.title: Compaction thrash guard
items.acceptance: Repeated low-yield compaction contracts the working set or returns an actionable bounded stop.

items.title: Verified outcome cost
items.acceptance: Observed request usage/cost is attributed to task outcomes; unknown pricing/usage remains unknown.

items.title: Investigation board
items.acceptance: Task memory separately records hypotheses, counterevidence, next tests, blockers and remaining budget.

items.title: Successful no-op detection
items.acceptance: Repeated successful unchanged observations do not count as novel progress.

items.title: Distinct recovery strategies
items.acceptance: Each retry records what changed and cannot repeat an identical failing strategy indefinitely.

items.title: Evidence-based escalation
items.acceptance: Escalation preserves task state and shared remaining budget and honors spending approvals.

items.title: Subagent contracts
items.acceptance: Children inherit bounded scope, objective, budget, expected artifact and completion contract.

items.title: Delegation accounting
items.acceptance: Delegation records observed usage, duplicated context and useful artifact outcomes without invented benefit.

items.title: Milestone invalidation
items.acceptance: Changed upstream verification marks dependent completion stale until reverified.

items.title: Compact durable handoffs
items.acceptance: Resume handoffs include next actions, blockers, revision, evidence refs and remaining limits within a fixed budget.

items.title: Language-aware local tracing
items.acceptance: Supported-language source/transform/guard/sink traces are structured and unsupported coverage is explicit.

items.title: Authorization tracing
items.acceptance: Local route-to-service traces retain observed guards, data boundaries and coverage gaps.

items.title: Negative controls
items.acceptance: Local reproduction evidence includes safe controls; missing controls cannot be silently treated as proof.

items.title: Proof stages
items.acceptance: Scanner candidates, model assessments, reproductions and verified fixes are distinct persisted states.

items.title: Reproducible fuzzing
items.acceptance: Local bounded fuzz cases retain seeds and minimized counterexamples without external targets.

items.title: Finding packages
items.acceptance: Export includes revision, prerequisites, evidence, reproduction, impact, remediation and verification disposition.

items.title: Surface coverage
items.acceptance: Security report tracks local entry points and investigated vulnerability classes with explicit gaps.

items.title: Search connection doctor
items.acceptance: Search setup validates enabled configuration, credential presence, supported tools and actionable failures.

items.title: Search provenance
items.acceptance: Research records citation URLs, retrieval timestamps, provider/tool and applicable version information.

items.title: Truthful run states
items.acceptance: UI distinguishes executing, waiting, stalled, blocked, incomplete and verified states using observed data.

items.title: Context debugger
items.acceptance: Users inspect bounded request composition, retrieval reasons and omissions without leaking credentials.

items.title: Recovery explanation
items.acceptance: Resume UI distinguishes saved-boundary continuation, new work and unknown-effect reconciliation.

items.title: Held-out benchmark gates
items.acceptance: Versioned local held-out coding/security/bug tasks include harmless controls and cannot prove real-model quality without model runs.

items.title: Model-profile regressions
items.acceptance: Profile activation compares observed completion/false positives/cost/latency/tool failures under shared budgets.

items.title: Commercial readiness gate
items.acceptance: Licenses, brand clearance, update signing, key storage, privacy, rollback and support have evidence fields; missing external evidence blocks release readiness.
